Appendix 8: Capability matrix template for Oil Spill Response Organisations
Use this capability matrix template to provide details of your organisation’s oil spill response capability. It is used to demonstrate the services you can provide, the response categories you operate in, and the personnel available to support a UK pollution incident response.
The Maritime Coastguard Agency’s (MCA) Responder Standards Capability Matrix helps organisations record and demonstrate their operational response capability.
You should use this template to:
- identify the categories of service provision you are applying for
- confirm which response activities your organisation can deliver
- record any specialist capabilities, such as aerial surveillance and verification, in-situ burning (ISB), subsea dispersant injection, or modelling
- provide details of personnel available to support a pollution incident response
